summary: This bill amends the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act to require local educational agencies to notify parents of children with disabilities that they can include other individuals with knowledge or expertise about their child in the individualized education program (IEP) team meetings.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA) to require local educational agencies to notify parents of their right to include other individuals with knowledge or special expertise in individualized education program (IEP) team meetings. This directly impacts the administration and parental involvement in special education, which is a component of public school services. It does not directly affect spending levels but aims to improve the process within existing public school frameworks.
